_comment: Hand-edited. official = pitched-battle D6, custom = group missions, each official entry carries its own deployment so Game Mode does not roll a second contradicting map.

official.name: Open Battle
official.deployment: zones A & B, long edges, alternate units

official.name: Break Point
official.deployment: zones A & B, long edges, alternate units
official.notes: Fight until an army hits break point.

official.name: Flank Attack
official.deployment: main force centre zone; flanking force on a chosen short-edge after both mains are down

official.name: Meeting Engagement
official.deployment: A & B; some units start in reserve (rolled per unit)

official.name: Mountain Pass
official.deployment: A & B on a long narrow table; long edges are cliff walls

official.name: Command & Control
official.deployment: A & B; one special feature in table centre

custom.name: Example — Raid the Baggage
custom.notes: Placeholder homebrew mission. Edit or replace with your group's own.

objectives.terrainPieces: Place a handful of terrain features, alternating.
objectives.objectiveMarkers: Add markers only if the chosen mission uses them.
